scientific_integrity: No claim of independent scientific review or formal certification. Only the general proof supports the infinite-family statement; finite exhaustive tests corroborate it.
scientific_limitations: Valid for odd prime p and length-two finite commutative chain rings; classical Z/p^2 case credited. Infinite proof plus six finite verification instances, not independent validation. Equivalence to unindexed prior cycle-index formulas remains a bibliographic risk.
title: The affine cycle-index distinction between equicharacteristic and mixed-characteristic length-two chain rings
